General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Healing Feat)

You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Improved Intuition. When you use the Medical Intuition benefit of your Mark of Healing feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

Improved Healing. You can now use the Healing Touch benefit of your Mark of Healing feat to cast Cure Wounds without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. In addition, when you cast Cure Wounds and roll dice to determine the Hit Points restored, you can treat any 1 or 2 as a 3.

Foundry Note

Improved Intuition: change the bonus of the Medical Intuition effect of your Mark of Healing feat from 1d4 to 1d6. Change the uses of the Cure Wounds of your Mark of Healing to your Proficiency Bonus (@prof).
